title: Send the family a receipt for every school fees payment
summary: The moment a payment is counted towards a student's school fees, however it came, send the family the receipt's number, the amount and the link that proves it, with a link to their fees page.
description: Starts the moment a payment is counted towards one of the school's term invoices: a transfer into the child's own account number, cash or a transfer posted at the desk, a payment matched in To match. Each such payment has a receipt already, numbered per term and issued as the money is counted. This sends the family's guardian one message, on the WhatsApp or Telegram they get the school's updates on, otherwise by SMS, and by email when the school has one: the receipt number, the amount, the invoice it paid and what is left on it, the link where anyone can check that the receipt is valid (the same the QR code on the PDF opens), and a fresh link to the family's fees page, where the receipt and its PDF are. It starts once per payment, so nobody gets a receipt twice; a payment on an invoice that is not a school's term invoice starts nothing here.

params.name: about
params.title: What the message is about
params.description: A few words a WhatsApp update names the message by, such as school fees receipt.

definition.name: School fees receipt
definition.description: Sends the family the receipt for each payment counted towards a term invoice.

input.title: ='Receipt ' + trigger.body.receipt.number
input.message: ='Receipt ' + trigger.body.receipt.number + ': we received ' + trigger.body.payment.amount + ' towards ' + trigger.body.number + ' (school fees). ' + (trigger.body.due_kobo > 0 ? 'A balance is still left on it. ' : 'The invoice is paid in full. ') + (has(trigger.body.receipt.link) ? 'Check the receipt: ' + trigger.body.receipt.link + ' ' : '') + (has(trigger.body.family_link) ? 'Your fees page, with the receipt and its PDF: ' + trigger.body.family_link : '')
